changeability.rationale: Domain formatting and API access are excellently centralized (format.ts, one data module), but the specific bug classes you'd actually ship — sprite derivation, card ordering, type labels, home filter params — each live in 2-3 duplicated places. All inside one or two files, so findable, but fixing is not one-edit.

coupling.rationale: Server and client code are cleanly separated with narrow DTO interfaces, and shared state is entirely explicit (URL search params). Only nits: the view-model contract types live inside the .server.ts module (type-only imports, so harmless, but a shared types file would be the cleaner seam), TypeBadge has an odd home, and Page is a manual convention rather than an enforced one.

evidence: app/src/components/PokemonCard.tsx:26-41 — PokemonCardList + CardData genuinely stretches across four different lists via optional fields (types for home, hiddenAbility for abilities) — designed around real variation
app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:48, 99 — column variation handled with a hasLevel boolean flag on table data, mild but acceptable

app/src/lib/data.server.ts:371-373, 655-662 — not-found modeled as a union return type per page-data function instead of the framework's notFound()/notFoundComponent, forcing every new detail route to copy the union + the head ternary + the component check (app/src/routes/abilities.$name.tsx:10-20, moves.$name.tsx:8-14)

app/src/routes/moves.$name.tsx:18-55 vs abilities.$name.tsx:19-37 — the detail-page skeleton (h1 + dl facts + panel sections + count + card list) is inlined per route with no shared section primitive, so an Items section is largely copied
app/src/lib/data.server.ts:165-191 — getAllTypeRecords/getAllGenerationRecords share a hand-rolled memoize-and-reset-cache pattern rather than a small helper
abstraction_design.rationale: The card and table abstractions are well-shaped and stretch to new cases, but the route/page layer has no reusable structure: not-found handling, page chrome and section markup are per-route boilerplate, so adding a sibling section means copying the Moves route, its loader wrapper and its not-found union rather than reusing code.

findings.issue: Missing resources are signaled by { notFound: true } union return types, which every route must thread through a component check and a head() ternary (app/src/routes/abilities.$name.tsx:10-20, moves.$name.tsx:8-14, types.$name.tsx:8-15, pokemon.$name.tsx:19-23) — four copies of plumbing the framework already provides via notFound() + notFoundComponent, and the URL-query-splat route ($.tsx) handles unmatched paths with a different mechanism entirely.
findings.suggestion: Throw notFound() from the loaders (or server fns) and declare a notFoundComponent (or a root defaultNotFoundComponent) once; delete the notFound unions from the page-data types.

findings.issue: The home filter search-param shape is encoded three times — validateSearch (:14-27), update's cleaned-object building (:50-73) and linkSearch (:76-84) — plus loaderDeps (:28-33) and HomeFilters in data.server.ts, so adding a fourth filter (e.g. sort) touches ~6 places with a real chance of drift.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single toHomeSearch(partial) helper used by validateSearch, update and linkSearch, so the param set is declared once.

findings.issue: Card-list shaping (dex sort at :636, :683, :755; type-label map at :267 and :742 duplicating getTypeLabelMap at :195; sprite fallback at :322 duplicating speciesCard's default at :220) is repeated across getMovePageData/getAbilityPageData/getTypePageData/getHomeData, so a change to how cards are ordered, labelled or illustrated lands in up to four functions.
findings.suggestion: Route all non-home card lists through one buildCardList(speciesRefs, opts) helper that owns sorting, labels and sprites; reuse getTypeLabelMap everywhere.

findings.issue: Banner, navigation, main wrapper and contentinfo landmark are opt-in per route via a Page component (wrapped in all 7 route files) instead of being enforced by the root route around <Outlet/> (app/src/routes/__root.tsx:28-31 renders only Outlet), so a new page that forgets <Page> silently loses the required landmarks and footer.
findings.suggestion: Move SiteHeader/SiteFooter and the <main> wrapper into the root route component (or a pathless layout route) so every route inherits them for free.

findings.issue: Card sprites are synthesized from the species id (mediaSprite) rather than taken from the API's front_default, bypassing the API's null signal for unshipped sprite sets; a broken-image rule or a sprite-source change must be fixed in two places (speciesCard :220 and getHomeData :322), and speciesCard's sync signature blocks a proper fix that needs the Pokémon record.
findings.suggestion: Make sprite derivation a single helper that prefers the Pokémon record's front_default and returns null when absent; have all card builders use it.

findings.issue: Two coexisting caching mechanisms — a per-URL promise cache (:102-104) plus two hand-rolled module-level memo promises with identical reset-on-error logic (:165-191) — mean a caching-rule change must be reconciled across both patterns.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the memoize-with-invalidation-on-error pattern in a small remember(key, factory) helper, or fold these into apiGet's cache.

findings.issue: Client components type-import their view-model contract (CardData, MoveRow, EvolutionNode at pokemon.$name.tsx:11) from the server-only module lib/data.server.ts; type-only imports are erased so nothing leaks at runtime, but the client/server contract lives in the server file and a future non-type import would break the build confusingly.
findings.suggestion: Move the exported DTO types (CardData, MoveRow, MoveTableData, EvolutionNode, page-data unions) to a shared lib/types.ts imported by both sides.

findings.issue: TypeBadge is exported from PokemonCard.tsx but is a cross-cutting primitive used by MoveTable (:4), types.index.tsx (:5), types.$name.tsx (:5) and moves.$name.tsx (:3), so removing the Pokémon card feature would drag the type badge along with it.
findings.suggestion: Move TypeBadge to its own components/TypeBadge.tsx.

summary: A well-structured TanStack Start app with an exemplary server/client seam: all PokeAPI access sits behind server functions in one module, and the framework's file-routing and generated route tree keep structural changes cheap. The costs are concentrated in the route and list layers, where not-found unions, the Page wrapper, card ordering, type-label maps and sprite derivation are copied per page instead of shared. Solid and pleasant to read, but adding a sibling section or changing card rendering means copying rather than reusing.
